dedupe_keys.name: earthquake resistant t shaped concrete walls with high strength steel bars wall t5 and t6

description: Earthquake-Resistant T-Shaped Concrete Walls with High-Strength Steel Bars: Wall T5 and T6 is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Andres Lepage, University of Kansas (ku.edu). For many year, ACI 318 limited the acceptable range of values for mechanical properties of reinforcing bars, including the yield strength, tensile-to-yield strength ratio, and fracture elongation. The maximum yield strength permitted for design purposes was set to prevent brittle failures of members and to attain sufficient deformation capacity. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: High-Strength Steel, High-Strength Reinforcement, Reinforced Concrete, T-Shaped Walls, Reverse Cyclic Loading, Earthquake Resistant. Published 2021-09-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
